title: pinus laricio subsp. poiretiana
intro: Pinus laricio subsp. poiretiana, commonly known as the Corsican pine, is a subspecies of evergreen coniferous tree native to the island of Corsica in France. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Pinus laricio subsp. poiretiana include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties, which can help to relieve coughs, colds, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
